answer_1.quote: We have implemented a working prototype of DisCo 1 and applied it to text classification and extractive summarization tasks.

answer_2.quote: Extractive summarization quality is evaluated with ROUGE. We report the full-length F1-based ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L (R-1, R-2, and R-L), and these ROUGE scores are computed using ROUGE-1.5.5.pl script.
